title: 晚
teacherNotes: Production package request for L209. Latest origin/main contains L206-L208, so there are no provisional learned characters. Production owns the asset-complete lesson-local package; Release owns production JSON, planner, ledger, registry cleanup, final verify, merge, and deploy.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main production JSON through L208 plus current target from newChars
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, station names, school names, timetables, clock numbers, subtitles, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate G02 suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice or cut production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 同一個孩子早上背著書包出門，晚上回到家門口。可用同一畫面分成左右兩個時間感，但不能有文字、數字、時鐘刻度或標籤。
小河從白天到夜晚都在流，可用同一條小河搭配左側白天、右側晚上星月光線的視覺對比。不可有文字、數字、標籤或聲音字樣。
傍晚或晚上，孩子在校門附近，大人提醒不要太晚進校門。校門不可有校名、文字、數字、標籤或招牌。

approvedSentences.text: 車站一天到晚有人進進出出。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 車站一天到晚有人進進出出
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 車站入口有很多人進進出出，畫面重點是人們在出入口來回進出。車站不可有站名、車次、文字、數字、時刻表、標籤或招牌。
晚上，孩子在窗邊往外看星星，畫面要清楚是人在窗邊看夜空。不可有文字、數字、星座標籤或字幕。

G01.reason: 「太晚」是本課核心時間用法，目標字清楚。
